Professional Summary
Data Engineer with hands-on experience building ETL pipelines and analytics platforms on AWS. Focused on reliable data ingestion, transformation, and delivery to downstream consumers. Not open to relocation; looking for roles in New Delhi only. Notice period: 30 days.

Technical Skills
Python, SQL, Apache Spark, dbt, AWS, Confluence, Jira, Git

- Implemented dbt models and CI pipelines with Git to standardize transformations, reducing data incidents by 25% and accelerating release cadence.
- Collaborated via Confluence and Jira to define data contracts and onboarding processes for new data sources, enabling three new data feeds in two quarters.

Big Data Engineer, GreenGrid (Sep 2024 - Dec 2025)
- Built scalable batch processing jobs using Apache Spark on AWS EMR to process meter and telemetry data, cutting nightly job runtime by 35% through optimized Spark SQL and partitioning.
- Created SQL-based validation suites and automated checks integrated into Git workflows to ensure data quality before downstream consumption.
- Documented data processing flows in Confluence and tracked tasks and incidents through Jira while coordinating deployments and rollback procedures.
